name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.add.QChatChannelAddMemberActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's permission settings. It lists server members who can be added to the channel; selecting a person adds them and opens their channel permission controls.
disableEffect: Users cannot add server members to a QChat channel through the built-in permission flow.
